VcuLedFrame.description: 16-byte LED/LCD frame image of the VCU display (bytes 0x200021c6..0x200021d5 in VCU_0159). The TM1640 driver sends it in order; digit glyphs and indicator bits are merged in with OR/AND masks by the frame helpers.

fields.name: tens_glyph_a
fields.description: Tens digit segment byte A from the glyph table seg_a (lcd_fb_show_number_2digit); some modes write 0xFF or 0xF0 here instead.

fields.name: tens_glyph_b
fields.description: Tens digit segment byte B in the low nibble (OR-ed in by lcd_fb_show_number_2digit); bits 4..6 are icon group A (mask 0x70).

fields.name: tens_glyph_c
fields.description: Tens digit segment byte C from the glyph table seg_c; some modes write 0x3F or 0xFF here.

fields.name: icon_bank_c9
fields.description: Icon bits: bits 4..6 (0x70) are icon group A (shared with tens_glyph_b and units_glyph_b), bits 0..1 are set by lcd_fb_set_c9_low2.

fields.name: units_glyph_a
fields.description: Units digit segment byte A from glyph table seg_a (written by lcd_fb_show_digit_units).

fields.name: units_glyph_b
fields.description: Units digit segment byte B in the low nibble (glyph table seg_b); bits 4..6 are icon group A.

fields.name: units_glyph_c
fields.description: Units digit segment byte C from glyph table seg_c; the mode pattern can set it to 0xCC.

fields.name: seg_bank_cd
fields.description: Low nibble is a segment pattern (0xC or 0x3) set by lcd_fb_set_cd_low_nibble; bits 4..6 are icon group B (0x70).

fields.name: chan_mask_ce
fields.description: Channel and segment mask byte; bits are set or cleared per channel by vcu_chan_mask_update and by the group helpers.

fields.name: chan_mask_cf
fields.description: Channel and segment mask byte of the same 9-bit group set as chan_mask_ce and chan_mask_d0.

fields.name: chan_mask_d0
fields.description: Channel and segment mask byte of the same 9-bit group set as chan_mask_ce and chan_mask_cf.

fields.name: ind_bank_d1
fields.description: Indicator bits: bit 0 (led_frame_set_group_all), bit 2 (lcd_fb_set_d1_bit2), bit 3 (set by the renderer from the 0x20001d38 flag), bit 4 (paired with ind_bank_d4 bit 3) and bit 6 (lcd_fb_set_d1_bit6).

fields.name: ind_bank_d2
fields.description: Bits 0..3 are the indicator pattern of the mode (led_frame_apply_mode_pattern); the low byte of the 16-bit output word set by led_frame_set_bit16 (with ind_bank_d3).

fields.name: ind_bank_d3
fields.description: High byte of the 16-bit output word set by led_frame_set_bit16 (bits 8..15 of the word formed with ind_bank_d2).

fields.name: ind_bank_d4
fields.description: Bits 0..1 (lcd_fb_set_d4_low2), bit 2 (lcd_fb_set_d4_bit2), bit 3 (paired with ind_bank_d1 bit 4), bits 4..5 (lcd_fb_set_d4_bits45) and bits 4..6 icon group B.

fields.name: ind_bank_d5
fields.description: Low nibble is icon group B (lcd_fb_set_icon_group_b sets 0x0F); the high nibble is cleared by the same helper.

VcuLedPatternRow.description: One row of the LED row-animation tables. In the index tables the first byte is the entry count and bytes 1..9 are LED frame byte indices; in the mask tables byte 0 is unused and bytes 1..9 are bit masks.

fields.name: count
fields.description: Number of valid entries in the row (index tables). Unused in the mask tables.

fields.name: entry
fields.description: Entry k (1..9): LED frame byte index in the index tables or the bit mask in the mask tables.
